data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. This issue can be caused by temporary problems with our preview rendering service or browser-specific rendering. First, please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies. If that doesn't help, try viewing the preview in an incognito/private browser window to rule out any browser extensions. If the problem is specific to a particular file, please ensure it's not password-protected or corrupted. [T-1378] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
